# Cosmic Signature

> Cosmic Signature is a procedural on-chain art protocol on Arbitrum. Every gesture shapes the cycle's final Signature, and the protocol redistributes its reserves across more than ten allocation tracks — including the infrastructure Ethereum itself depends on.

## Overview

Cosmic Signature is a procedural on-chain art protocol on Arbitrum. Participants make gestures during a Performance Cycle; when the cycle finalizes, the protocol distributes its reserves across more than ten allocation tracks — including Protocol Guild, the funding mechanism for 170+ Ethereum core contributors. The protocol runs on Arbitrum, a Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, providing fast and low-cost transactions.

Cosmic Signature is not related to the COSMIC cancer mutation database or COSMIC mutational signatures in biology.

## Protocol Mechanics

- Each cycle opens with ETH and CST Calibration Window mechanics; the CST window starts from a 12-hour reference and then changes on-chain
- Every gesture adds the current time increment to Cycle Finalization Time; the increment starts at 1 hour and grows 1% per finalized cycle
- The participant who made the Final Gesture when the Cycle Finalization Time expires may finalize the cycle and receive the Signature Allocation (25% of the Cycle Reserve, 1,000 CST, and 1 Cosmic Signature NFT); gestures remain possible until finalization executes
- The Final Gesture participant has a 48-hour exclusive finalization window; afterwards anyone may finalize and the finalizer receives the Signature Allocation
- Every gesture records a Stellar Selection entry and may imprint dynamic Participation CST
- Participation CST uses a square-root formula based on elapsed time since the previous gesture; rapid gestures can imprint 0 CST, while longer quiet periods imprint more
- CST gestures increase the CST Calibration Window by about 0.4%; ETH gestures decrease it by about 0.398%
- In the vast majority of cycles, 24 Cosmic Signature NFTs are imprinted and paired with 24,000 CST
- Three ETH Stellar Selection recipients share 4% of the Cycle Reserve
- Ten NFT Stellar Selection recipients and ten RandomWalk NFT anchor-holders each receive 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT (selections are drawn with replacement)
- The Chrono-Warrior receives 8% of the Cycle Reserve, 1,000 CST, and 1 Cosmic Signature NFT
- The Endurance Champion and Final CST Gesture recipient each receive 1,000 CST and 1 Cosmic Signature NFT
- Anchor Distributions route 6% of the Cycle Reserve to Cosmic Signature NFT anchor-holders; accumulated ETH is paid out when an anchor is released
- Every NFT can be anchored only once, ever; releasing an anchor permanently ends that NFT's anchoring eligibility
- 7% of each Cycle Reserve is forwarded to Protocol Guild (public goods)
- Outreach Reserve imprints 3,000 CST per cycle, bringing typical fixed end-of-cycle/outreach CST imprints to 27,000 CST before dynamic per-gesture CST
- Participants can make gestures with ETH or CST tokens (CST uses its own Calibration Window); the first gesture of each cycle must be an ETH gesture
- Secondary ETH and attached-asset allocations use a 5-week retrieval timeout, after which anyone may retrieve unretrieved allocations for themselves
- RandomWalkNFT holders can attach an unused token to an ETH gesture for a 50% ETH Gesture Cost reduction; each RandomWalkNFT can be used once for this discount
- RandomWalkNFTs can also be anchored for Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection eligibility (no ETH distributions)

## Tokens

- **CST tokens**: ERC-20 coordination and utility tokens; trade on Uniswap on Arbitrum
- **Cosmic Signature NFT**: ERC-721 generative art based on three-body problem physics; trades on Axiom Zero, the zero-fee marketplace
- **RandomWalkNFT**: Partner ERC-721 that can be attached to an ETH gesture for a one-time 50% ETH Gesture Cost reduction, or anchored for Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection eligibility

## Ecosystem

- [Axiom Zero](https://www.axiomzero.market/cosmic-signature): The zero-fee NFT marketplace for Cosmic Signature and RandomWalk NFTs on Arbitrum. Trades settle directly on-chain, and every token page labels the NFT's anchor status (never anchored vs anchored) read live from the anchoring contracts.
- [Chaos Zero](https://chaoszero.com): The prediction market built specifically for Cosmic Signature. Each Performance Cycle opens one question — will this cycle finalize with more gestures than the previous one? Positions are denominated in CST and fully collateralized by construction, with no owner or admin keys.
- [Uniswap CST trading](https://app.uniswap.org/swap?chain=arbitrum&inputCurrency=NATIVE&outputCurrency=0xAD91843e6A58Ba560F577E676986AFb1dba6FBA0): Swap ETH for CST on Arbitrum.

## Technical

- Blockchain: Arbitrum (Ethereum Layer 2)
- Smart contracts: Open-source Solidity contracts, exact-match verified on-chain; owner-controlled parameters until ownership moves under Cosmic Council control (independently audited by Hacken; report and formal-verification status: https://app.cosmicsignature.com/audits)
- NFT art: Generated from on-chain seeds using an open-source Rust program
- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript

## 中文概览

Cosmic Signature 是运行于 Arbitrum 的程序化链上艺术协议。参与者在演绎周期中落笔；每一笔都会影响周期最终的签名作品。周期收官后，协议按公开规则将周期储备发往十余条分配轨道，其中包括支持以太坊核心贡献者的 Protocol Guild。

Cosmic Signature 与 COSMIC 癌症突变数据库及生物学中的 COSMIC 突变特征没有关联。

### 协议要点

- 每个周期以 ETH 与 CST 校准窗口机制开启；CST 窗口从 12 小时基准出发，并随链上参与变化
- 每次落笔都会按当前时间增量延长收官倒计时；该增量从 1 小时起步，每有一个周期收官便增长 1%
- 写下收官之笔的参与者拥有 48 小时专属收官窗口；之后任何人均可收官，实际收官者获得签名分配
- 每周期储备的 25% 进入签名分配，8% 发往时之勇士，4% 由 3 个 ETH 星选资格共享，6% 用于锚定派发，7% 发往 Protocol Guild，约 50% 滚入下一周期
- 绝大多数周期会铭刻 24 枚 Cosmic Signature NFT，并配套 24,000 CST；连同 3,000 CST 推广储备，典型固定铭刻总量为 27,000 CST，另有按落笔动态计算的参与 CST
- 每枚 Cosmic Signature NFT 或 RandomWalk NFT 一生只能锚定一次；解锚后不再具备锚定资格
- 未使用的 RandomWalk NFT 可附加至一笔 ETH 落笔，使该笔 ETH 落笔价格降低 50%；每枚 RandomWalk NFT 只能用于这项减免一次
- 次级 ETH 与已附加资产设有 5 周取回期限；期限结束后，任何人都可为自己取回仍未取回的分配

### 生态

- [Axiom Zero](https://www.axiomzero.market/cosmic-signature)：Arbitrum 上不收平台费的 NFT 市场
- [Chaos Zero](https://chaoszero.com)：面向 Cosmic Signature 周期的预测市场；每周期的问题是本周期收官时的落笔数是否高于上一周期
